profiles.name: Flamer of Tzeentch
notes: Warpfire is a source-defined Breath type with no fixed Damage rating given. On failed Dodge, make a Challenging Endurance Test and take Moderate Corruption regardless of result. On failure take normal attack Damage and 1 Ablaze, with Minor Corruption each round while Ablaze persists. On success take no Damage and gain Regeneration for 1d10 rounds with cosmetic changes to healed flesh. Keep source reference manual until Damage is established.
Font of Flame permits Breath on 8+ on a d10 at the start of a turn if Momentum is insufficient (printed Advantage, Fifth Edition core compatibility p. 364).
